commit_message: Add typed engine Timeline runtime adapter
pr_title: Implement ADR 0126 Timeline and Sequencer runtime
pr_body:
Adds the concrete top-level engine adapter that dispatches neutral Timeline evaluations to strongly typed Animation, Transform, Camera, Audio, VFX, and Event domain operations without moving domain logic into engine-timeline. The PR remains Draft until ADR 0126 Definition of Done and required Windows/Visual validation complete.
